monitored_text: CNC Aluminum Turning Services & CNC Turned Aluminum Parts Aluminium is a lightweight, non-magnetic, soft silver metal. By adding small amounts of elements such as copper, magnesium and zinc, aluminum can be made stronger. The unparalleled physical properties of aluminum allow it to be formed into almost any shape. It can be rolled into thick plates for armored tanks or thin foil for packaging, or it can be drawn into wire and made into cans. Aluminum CNC Turning is one of the most commonly used techniques for aluminum manufacturing. Due to its excellent characteristics and low processing cost, turning aluminum parts are widely used in automotive, machinery, medical, aerospace, electronics and other industries. Properties of Aluminum: Easily machined Great Mechanical resistance Excellent corrosion and chemical resistance High strength-to-weight ratio Good thermal and electrical conductivity Ductility, malleability Reflects heat and light Waterproofing, barrier effect Reflective properties Recyclability China Top-Grade Precision Aluminum CNC Turning Supplier From co-development to the industrialization of your product, Junying (CNClathing.com)- China Top Aluminum CNC turning services supplier, is involved in the CNC Aluminum Turned Parts production of small, medium, large and very large series. Our CNC turning center for aluminum components exclusively consists of state-of-the-art CNC turning machines and skillful engineers to satisfy our customers’ requirements. Whatever the complexity of the aluminum part to be turned, we optimize manufacturing costs by respecting deadlines and quality of manufacture. Today, we realize any type of CNC aluminum machining production run ranging from the small amount to the million pieces and are able to machine all types of aluminum materials.
